subject: Year-end accelerator retainer: pricing request and sign-off needed
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Patel <sara@cloudthera.com>, procurement@cloudthera.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 27 Dec 2026 14:02:00 -0800
Subject: Proposal: year-end accelerator retainer + pilot pricing

Hi Sara / CloudThera procurement team,

Thanks again for the time today — really encouraged by the technical fit between your summarization pipeline and our KV-prefetch batching (will help with latency at scale). Per our conversation, I pulled together two commercial options to close before year-end so CloudThera can kick off the 90-day accelerator in Q1 with predictable economics. Attached: discount analysis and the SOW draft.

Option A (recommended for speed): 12-month retainer, $120k committed spend, 35% one-time onboarding credit + 20% recurring discount on hosted API usage for first 6 months.
Option B (lower initial commitment): 6-month pilot, $60k committed, 20% onboarding credit + 10% recurring discount.

Customer ask: they are pushing for a 40% recurring discount in exchange for a pilot-to-enterprise promise. They need final commercial yes/no by close of business Wed (12/29) to secure their internal budget for kickoff.

Ask of Redwood: I need an internal approval path for anything >20% recurring discount or >$100k one-off credits. If we can do 35% one-time credit + 20% recurring (Option A) without exec sign-off, we’ll proceed; otherwise please advise approval steps.

Attachments: discount_analysis_CloudThera.xlsx (analysis), SOW_CloudThera_v2.pdf (draft)

Next steps: Sara, if you can confirm preferred option I'll push a final SOW + DocuSign link as soon as I get internal CS/finance sign-off.

Thanks,
Karthik
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
phone: (415) 555-0191

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 28 Dec 2026 09:07:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Proposal: year-end accelerator retainer + pilot pricing

Karthik — thanks for the summary and the fast turnaround. I reviewed the attachments quickly. A few points:

1) Trade-offs: 35% onboarding credit + 20% recurring for first 6 months is reasonable if we tie to a 12-month, non-cancelable retainer and minimum monthly commit. We need an explicit price-protection clause after month 6 (revert to standard list or agreed floor).

2) Risk: CloudThera is a strategic prospect but their requested 40% recurring is outside our standard guardrails. Anything >20% recurring or >$100k in credits needs VP/CFO authorization per the commercial playbook (see policy excerpt in the internal drive).

3) Recommendation: Approve Option A modified: 30% onboarding credit (cap to $36k) + 20% recurring for 6 months, with a commitment to commit $120k over 12 months, and a phased ramp clause (month 1-3 min usage). This gives them headline savings while keeping total concession within a controllable ceiling.

Karthik — please prepare a one-page memo for exec review that includes ARR upside, churn sensitivity, and a fallback if they ask for a 40% recurring discount (we should offer a technical add-on or extended support in lieu of higher price concession). Laura / Lauren: tagging you for finance / commercial cleanup — can you run the quick ARR accretion calc and confirm the $36k cap for onboarding credit? I need a clean approval packet for Markus (VP) by EOD Wed.

-Marissa
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 29 Dec 2026 11:42:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Proposal: year-end accelerator retainer + pilot pricing — exec approval request

Markus / Laura — forwarding the thread. Quick summary for exec review:

- Account: CloudThera (prospect). Deal: HB-5721.
- Proposed commercial: 12-month $120k retainer, onboarding credit 30% (cap $36k), 20% recurring discount for first 6 months.
- Customer asked for 40% recurring. We countered with 20% + stronger onboarding credit and ramp protections.
- Drivers for approval: strategic reference in industrial search, potential platform integration (multi-region), expected ARR conversion to $450k ARR if they expand to enterprise in 12–18 months.
- Required approval: commercial policy requires VP/CFO sign-off for recurring discounts >20% or credits >$100k. Our ask is for a discretionary sign-off to allow the 30% onboarding cap + 20% recurring (explicitly below the >20% recurring threshold but the additive economics warrant a VP check).

I attached the analysis and the SOW. If we get a green light I will finalize SOW and route DocuSign. Time sensitivity: customer wants confirmation before COB 12/29 to align with their procurement window.

Decision options:
- Approve as-is (Marissa's recommended structure).
- Approve but require a shorter trial (90 days) before awarding the onboarding credit in full.
- Decline and offer 10–15% recurring + professional services credits instead.

Markus — can you advise? If you prefer I can join a 30-minute sync with you and finance this afternoon.

Forwarded attachments: discount_analysis_CloudThera.xlsx, SOW_CloudThera_v2.pdf

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Sara Patel <sara@cloudthera.com>, procurement@cloudthera.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 30 Dec 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Proposal: year-end accelerator retainer + pilot pricing — approval and conditional sign-off

Team / CloudThera — after reviewing the packet and the upside case I will provide conditional approval. Final commercial sign-off below:

Approved commercial summary (conditional):
- 12-month retainer, $120k committed.
- Onboarding credit: 30% capped at $36,000 (applies once the first three monthly usage minimums are met).
- Recurring discount: 20% on hosted API usage for first 6 months only.
- Non-financial concession: one week of dedicated on-call support during onboarding window (to be delivered by Solutions Engineering).
- Price protection: after month 6 pricing reverts to the contracted floor (no retroactive credits).

Conditions:
1) Karthik to add a non-guaranteed clause in SOW that ties credit payout to verified usage thresholds (we'll define metric table).
2) DocuSign to include an executive attestation: procurement acknowledges the conditional nature of onboarding credit.
3) Final sign-off by Finance (Laura) on revenue recognition treatment (confirm cap treatment).

Karthik/Sara: proceed to finalize the SOW with the conditions above. I'll sign the DocuSign once Finance confirms the ARR treatment (Laura, please confirm by EOD today). If Finance flags anything material that changes exposure, we will revert.

Markus Klein
VP, Commercial Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: signature_template.docx (fillable approval stub).
